config.z80z_elytra_trail.title: Elytra Trails · Config
config.z80z_elytra_trail.opt.shape.name: Trail position
config.z80z_elytra_trail.opt.shape.tip: Where the trail appears: central streamer, wing-tip lines, or both.
config.z80z_elytra_trail.opt.style.name: Trail style
config.z80z_elytra_trail.opt.style.tip: Color effect of the trail ribbon: Dust follows your dye color, Rainbow shifts hues automatically, other styles add matching spark particles on top.
config.z80z_elytra_trail.opt.stardust.ti: Scatter end-rod sparks along the trail.
config.z80z_elytra_trail.opt.water_drops: Bubble droplets while gliding; much more frequent in rain.
config.z80z_elytra_trail.opt.afterimages: Leave a particle silhouette behind every 0.5 seconds.
Wind while gliding; volume and pitch follow your speed.
config.z80z_elytra_trail.opt.rocket_soun: A boom when a firework boost starts.
config.z80z_elytra_trail.opt.smart_shedd: Halve the particle budget when FPS is low or particle settings are reduced.
config.z80z_elytra_trail.opt.particle_li: Max trail particles this mod may spawn per client tick; shared by all players.
config.z80z_elytra_trail.opt.low_fps.tip: FPS below this triggers load shedding (requires smart load shedding).
config.z80z_elytra_trail.opt.mode.name: Activation mode
config.z80z_elytra_trail.opt.mode.tip: When trails appear: gliding, high speed, rocket boosts only, or custom.
config.z80z_elytra_trail.opt.glide_speed: GLIDE mode: trail appears above this speed (blocks/s).
HIGH_SPEED mode: trail appears above this speed (blocks/s).
config.z80z_elytra_trail.opt.custom_spee: Speed gate used by CUSTOM mode (blocks/s).
config.z80z_elytra_trail.opt.custom_requ: CUSTOM mode also requires an active firework boost.
config.z80z_elytra_trail.opt.rocket_memo: How long a boost still counts as active after the rocket ends (ticks).
config.z80z_elytra_trail.note.audio: Tip: wind volume and pitch adapt to your glide speed automatically.
config.z80z_elytra_trail.note.performanc: The particle budget is shared by all trails; exceeding it thins trails instead of dropping frames.
config.z80z_elytra_trail.note.activation: Connected to a server: activation is decided by the server config; shown read-only below.
Enter a world to view and adjust activation settings.
